description: Point a subdomain you own (e.g. blog.yourdomain.com) at your Rynn-hosted blog. Sets the CNAME plus the ownership TXT record so the site goes live and its certificate can issue.
variableDescription: host: the subdomain label being connected (e.g. blog). cnametarget: the Rynn fallback-origin CNAME target. txtvalue: the Cloudflare custom-hostname ownership token.
